title: Confident Fools or Careful Searchers? A Behavioural Study of When LLMs Search Beyond Their Static Internal Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.41124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic LLM assistants must repeatedly decide whether to answer from memory or to call a tool such as web search. Unnecessary searches cost latency and money; missing ones yield confident but unsupported answers. Prior work mostly measures verbalised confidence or trains new adaptive-retrieval methods, and rarely audits the search decisions that deployed products actually make. We introduce a benchmark of 400 multiple-choice questions that combines widely known inside-knowledge (IK) questions, which should be answered directly, with outside-knowledge (OK) questions about facts from news published after the models' training cut-offs (to our knowledge), which should trigger search or, without tools, abstention. Each item offers an abstain option, and two action-level scores, NAS and KIS, reward searching on OK questions and restraint on IK questions. Across five commercial LLMs with and without their vendors' web search, GPT-5 mini and Gro

translated_title: 自信的傻瓜还是谨慎的搜索者？关于LLM何时在静态内部记忆之外进行搜索的行为学研究
translated_abstract: 智能体式LLM助手必须反复决定是直接从记忆中回答，还是调用网络搜索等工具。不必要的搜索会消耗延迟和成本；而缺失的搜索则会产生自信却缺乏依据的回答。以往工作大多衡量口头表达的置信度，或训练新的自适应检索方法，很少审计已部署产品实际做出的搜索决策。我们引入了一个包含400道选择题的基准，将应该直接回答的广为人知的内部知识（IK）题目，与外部知识（OK）题目相结合——后者涉及模型训练截止日期（据我们所知）之后发布的新闻事实，应当触发搜索，或在无工具可用时选择弃权。每个题目都提供弃权选项，并设置两个动作层面的评分——NAS和KIS——分别奖励在外部知识题目上的搜索行为和内部知识题目上的克制行为。在五种商业LLM上，无论是否开启其厂商的网页搜索，GPT-5 mini和Gro……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个包含400道选择题的基准，通过NAS和KIS两个动作层面的评分，审计五种商业LLM在“内部知识应直接回答、外部知识应触发搜索或弃权”场景下实际做出的搜索决策行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a 400-question benchmark with two action-level scores, NAS and KIS, to audit the actual search decisions of five commercial LLMs, distinguishing inside-knowledge questions that should be answered directly from outside-knowledge questions that should trigger search or abstention.
